This Rigging's effect: While this armor is worn, you may use the Defensive Step Equipment Reaction.

Defensive Step (EC04)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self / Self

Trigger: Another character declares an attack against your Fortitude; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Increase your Fortitude by 1 against the triggering attack. Roll only to generate Surges.

Surge 1: After the triggering attack resolves, move 1 unit. Once per use.

Design note: This Reaction does not provide a second Reaction window for its user against the same Action.
